scripts.build: next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('.next/standalone')) { fs.mkdirSync('.next/standalone/public', {recursive: true}); fs.mkdirSync('.next/standalone/.next/static', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('public', '.next/standalone/public', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('.next/static', '.next/standalone/.next/static', {recursive: true}); try { fs.mkdirSync('.next/standalone/frontend/public', {recursive: true}); fs.mkdirSync('.next/standalone/frontend/.next/static', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('public', '.next/standalone/frontend/public', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('.next/static', '.next/standalone/frontend/.next/static', {recursive: true}); } catch(e){} }"
